notes.title: An update on Together, it's future and temporal anti-aliasing distortion
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Together hasn't progressed much since launch, and I apologize for that. This has been due to a combination of personal circumstances, technical complexity, and financial constraints.

I would like to reimagine Together and eventually bring it to mobile, but it needs to be done properly, which will be costly. Unfortunately, I am no longer in a position to self-fund this project.

I recently booted up Together for the first time in ages on a Meta Quest 3 and noticed that the temporal anti-aliasing was causing significant visual distortion in the distance, particularly noticeable on the trees. I believe this is a resolution issue, and it wasn't apparent on devices like the Rift S (which I developed on).

As such, I want to apologize to anyone who has experienced this issue, and I will be removing the price tag from the project for now.

notes.title: New winter environment and full WMR support added
notes.content:
- New Winter environment for up to 4 players
- Windows Mixed Reality (WMR, G2) input support
- Improved Valve Index (Knuckles) input support
- Imporved Oculus input support when running through SteamVR (longpress B/Y for menu)
- Improved performance for Low quality setting (slider)
- Other fixes

notes.title: Playtest is open now!
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest for Nature Treks: Together is now open.[/h1]

Anyone that is interested in helping playtest the experience please press the 'Join the Nature Treks: Together (Playtest)' button on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521040/Nature_Treks_Together/]store page[/url]. If you can take the time to do this it will be very helpful and appreciated. Access will be granted at some point next week.

There are 2 main reasons for delaying early access in favor of playtesting.
Firstly multiplayer needs testing with a significant number of users to iron out any issues that might occur with larger numbers. 
Secondly, inputs for non Oculus devices need more work, specifically, we need to add in a separate character controller to support those to the extent we would like. However, the experience is still playable using Vive, Index, and WMR.

Early Access for us was never about releasing something with known issues. It was always about releasing a solid foundation to evolve and grow with feedback from the community.

We will probably need to organize specific multiplayer sessions for larger-scale multiplayer. The community hub can be used for this. I will be active on the community hub.

Just some clarity on supported devices. We develop using Oculus devices and the experience is still best played using one. This will change once we add in a unique character controller for other devices, however for now please expect some quirks. Vive inputs are pretty solid.

Please refer to the '[url=https://store.steampowered.com/manual/1521040]view the manual[/url]' link on the store page for a list of inputs and a user guide for the experience.

Early Access will be pushed back to September. I have sent a request to steam to change the date listed on the store page to reflect this.

Any questions please post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521040/discussions/]community hub[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/5FqZwbgx53]discord server[/url] or contact me via [url=jcarline@greenergames.net]email[/url].

Look forward to seeing you inside Nature Treks: Together

Best
John
